subject: URGENT FINDING c6t-rca-opus: C6u black screen = SpringBoard CRASH LOOP (SIGABRT in MPS on D8F18H), not the compile time
body: xnu-live.log c6u-test: 15+ 'CRASH SpringBoard[pid] sig 6' (lines 7326, 8669, 10648, ... 30090, new pid each ~1700 lines). Each preceded by 'TEGU_AIR_REFUSED kernel D8F18H rc=2: air: linked functions / stage input are not adapted to AIR yet' then SpringBoard's own message: MetalPerformanceShaders MPSCore/Utility/MPSLibrary.mm:550 'failed assertion MPSKernel MTLComputePipelineStateCache unable to load function D8F18H' -> abort. 171 D8F18H refusals total. C6u's AIR-only compute (no m2v fallback) makes newComputePipelineState for this MPS kernel return nil; MPS asserts instead of handling nil. With SpringBoard dead and relaunching every few seconds, nothing reaches the screen after the logo. Fix options for af49a233/root: (a) compute AIR refusal of linked-function/stage-input kernels -> fall back to the m2v compute path for those (C6t behaviour), switch for A/B; (b) implement linked functions in AIR compute. Until then C6u is not bootable to UI. Slow compiles: the multi-second ones (backboardd 8647 ms, SpringBoard 7621 ms) coincide with the first crash/relaunch; host AIR compile of every CA record is <=12 ms (exact, runtime-spec, and without constants: gpu/build/c6t-rca-20261028/c6u/timing_*.log), so no pathological shader; continuing on that and on pipeline_keys.py.
